import os,json,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
di,do=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
def f(g):
    cols=sorted(set(v for r in g for v in r))
    m={c:i for i,c in enumerate(cols)}
    return [[m[v] for v in r] for r in g]
print(f(di)==do)
out=f(G['Test input']); print(json.dumps(out))
os.makedirs('programs',exist_ok=True)
json.dump([{'input':di,'output':do}],open('programs/task-554f7996.json','w'))
open('programs/task-554f7996.py','w').write("def transform(grid):\n    cols=sorted(set(v for r in grid for v in r))\n    m={c:i for i,c in enumerate(cols)}\n    return [[m[v] for v in row] for row in grid]\n")
